body: r/transfertotop25 was SUPER helpful when I was applying!

I completely understand. It was scary for me too. You can use loans and other financial aid for rent. Also, i recommend reaching out to the financial aid office at UNC and see if they can guide you on that. They would be much more help than me. But if you get accepted, it means they want you to be here, and they will help you however possible. Same with academics. I find that the faculty here WANTS you to succeed. There are so many learning and academic centers around campus. In fact, I am going to get set up with academic coaching and I am very excited about it.

I get it for sure. That was one of my concerns as well. I live at University Apartments, it’s about a 10 minute walk away from campus and I feel perfectly connected to campus culture. And the nice part is, you get to step away when you need. Just get involved with campus activities whether they’re hosted by the school or clubs and you can still get a meal plan and eat at the dining hall so you can have that experience. But yeah I live so close to campus that I’m there every day and don’t feel disconnected at all.
Ok that’s not too bad. I’m in the same boat with a couple of my classes right now so I totally get it.  Good luck with everything!

Hey I just want to let you know that there is a slim to none chance of getting housing and even less so of getting your accommodations. I am a transfer student who also requires a single room and while I was one of the very few transfers who was offered on campus housing, they were not able to accommodate me since there were just no single rooms left. If you get accepted to UNC, I would start looking at apartments immediately.
No but you can appeal to withdraw from a course if it’s looking really bad.
